plan.summary: G6: Flow state persistence. New action_wait_until node + flow_execution_state table + 60s FlowWaitResumerService enables restart-safe long waits (up to 30 days) for Dent rescue flows. User reply during wait cancels pending wait and continues normal flow.
plan.q_intent: G6 Flow state persistence (2-3g) — flow_execution_state tablosu, 1.5 gun wait restart-safe. Orta risk.
plan.interview_notes: Q kararları: (1) Yeni action_wait_until node (action_delay dokunulmayacak, ≤300sn in-memory kalır). (2) Scheduler CronSchedulerService pattern'i ile 60sn timer. (3) Yeni flow_execution_state tablosu (chat_sessions ayrı). (4) Edge case in-scope: user reply wait'i iptal eder + devam, max wait 30 gün, metrics endpoint (pending/overdue count). (5) OUT-of-scope: flow versioning snapshot (eski versiyonla devam).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: action_wait_until node tipi eklenir; wait_seconds/wait_hours/wait_days/wait_until_iso config'lerinden birini okur, 30 günlük üst limit clamp uygular, 1sn altı reddeder (INV-AT-060).

flow_execution_state tablosu migration 010 ile oluşur (tenant_id, flow_id, chat_id, phone, instance_id, node_id, resume_at, session_state JSONB, status, created_at, resumed_at, max_wait_at). (status, resume_at) ve (tenant_id, chat_id, status) indeksleri var.

FlowWaitResumerService (IHostedService) 60sn timer ile status='pending' AND resume_at<=now() rows'larını fetch eder, her row için orchestrator.ResumeWaitAsync çağırır, başarı sonrası status='resumed'+resumed_at=now(); failure status='failed' (INV-AT-059). Process restart sonrası pending rows hâlâ resume edilir (restart-safe).

Wait sırasında user mesajı gelirse orchestrator önce FlowWaitRepository.CancelPendingForChatAsync çağırır (status='cancelled'), wait iptal olur, normal flow devam eder. Aynı chat_id için aynı anda tek active pending kaydı olabilir.
GET /ops/flow-waits endpoint'i SuperAdmin auth ile { pending_count, overdue_count (resume_at<now()-5dk AND status=pending) } döner.
Build PASS (full solution). FlowValidator action_wait_until node tipini tanır. Mevcut flows (action_delay içeren) regression yok.

files_changed.change: NEW: flow_execution_state table + 3 indexes (status/resume_at, tenant/chat/status, created_at)
INV-AT-057/058/059/060 const fields (additive, no breaking change)
NEW: IHostedService 60s timer, atomic claim, batch=100, non-overlapping ticks
NEW: action_wait_until handler, 30g max clamp, 4 duration formats + ISO, simulation skip
WaitPersist case: advance CurrentNodeId post-wait, return WaitRequest in EngineStepResult
action_wait_until added to RequiredFields (label only; duration validated at runtime)
Inject FlowWaitRepository + cancel-on-reply path + PersistWaitAsync + public ResumeWaitAsync (used by resumer)
DI: FlowWaitRepository, ActionWaitUntilHandler, FlowWaitResumerService (HostedService) + GET /api/ops/flow-waits endpoint

build.output_tail: Build succeeded. 2 Warning(s) 0 Error(s). Both warnings pre-existing (NU1603 Marketing/Hosting.WindowsServices, CS8600 Orchestrator line 333).

verification_questions.question: FlowWaitResumerService process restart sonrası pending wait rows'larını kaybetmeden resume edebiliyor mu (in-memory state yok, tek kaynak DB)?
User reply geldiğinde CancelPendingForChatAsync, ResumeWaitAsync ile race condition'a girmeden önce çağrılıyor mu (aynı chat için concurrent execution)?
30 gün max wait limit handler tarafında mı clamp ediliyor, yoksa sadece DB constraint mi (silent clamp vs. explicit reject)?
flow_execution_state tablosu tenant_id filter'ı olmadan sorgulanıyor mu (cross-tenant sızıntı riski)?

non_goals: Flow versioning snapshot (wait sırasında flow değişirse eski graph'la devam — OUT)
Wait node'da complex expression evaluation (sabit duration/timestamp yeterli)
Multiple concurrent waits per chat (MVP: tek active pending)
Dashboard UI for pending waits (ops endpoint yeterli)
intentional_exclusions: Retry policy on resume failure (failed status sonrası manual intervention)

try_catch_locations: FlowWaitResumerService.OnTimerTick: toplu fetch + per-row resume, row-level failure diğerlerini etkilemez
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Resume failure INV-AT-059 ile log'lanır + status='failed' + GET /ops/flow-waits overdue_count'a yansır. CancelPendingForChatAsync sonucu (rows affected) orchestrator tarafından log'lanır.
